Question B-006-013-002.

Why the correct answer is right: A delta loop array uses triangular loop elements, each about one wavelength around, with parasitic triangular loops added to make a directional antenna.

Why the distractors are wrong:
- sourceIndex 1: "An antenna made of a large multi-turn triangular loop": Multiple turns would make a coil-like loop. A delta loop antenna element is a single triangular full-wave loop.
- sourceIndex 2: "An antenna system made of three vertical antennas, arranged in a triangular shape": That would be a vertical array layout. A delta loop is named for triangular wire loop elements, not three separate verticals.
- sourceIndex 3: "An antenna made from several triangular coils of wire on an insulating form": Triangular coils would be inductors or loading components. The antenna elements here are full-size triangular loops.
